integrity: Complete proof from a triangular permutation of finite-state words; independent exhaustive implementations with full captured outputs and their source code are included. All numerical checks have finite scope.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns finite acyclic complete orientations, threshold-one directed-out-neighbor triggering, and k>=3; it does not extend automatically to general digraphs or other thresholds. The earliest foundational arXiv source was inspected in abstract only, and absolute priority is not established; independent audit has not been performed.
title: Binomial excitation clocks for multistate Greenberg–Hastings dynamics on transitive tournaments
